selected_contract.rationale: A newly discovered user-visible output may be recorded as blocked/uncovered, but product acceptance stays red until it is either covered with reviewed evidence or removed. New managed classes also require an explicit machine-contract update rather than silently appearing.

retirement_condition: Retire this overlay-specific invariant only when N.E.K.O exposes one native authoritative delivery-surface manifest that includes extension publications and the XiaoYu architecture gate can consume it directly without losing private final-admission semantics.
